briefs.why_this_angle: UGC | Salon owner | Night-before texts has the best hook in the account: 38.0% of impressions watched 3 seconds, against a median of 29.5%. 2 creator-style market ads open the same way (a business owner on the cost of no-shows).

1_overview.objective: Get salon and barber owners who still confirm bookings by hand to create an account
1_overview.judged_on: cost per sign-up, with the 3-second view rate read first
1_overview.benchmark: UGC | Salon owner | Night-before texts: hook rate 38.0%, hold rate 26.3%, cost per sign-up $34.63
1_overview.creator: A salon or barbershop owner with 2 to 6 chairs who books clients by text today; warm and a little tired of it, not a presenter
1_overview.where: Their own chair or front desk, between clients
1_overview.product_use: Shows the reminder settings once, then a client's confirmation arriving on their phone

5_technical.file: MP4 or MOV, at least 1080 wide
5_technical.framing: film vertical with the face and the phone screen in the middle, so the 4:5 Feed crop still works
5_technical.filming: daylight or a well-lit chair or studio, face lit from the front; a quiet moment between clients, phone close for clear sound
5_technical.safe_zones: keep text and faces out of the top and bottom edges, where the platforms put buttons and captions
5_technical.full_cut: 22 seconds (the best converter's video length, from get_ad_videos)
5_technical.cut_down: about 11 seconds: hook, one proof point, CTA
5_technical.product_on_screen_by: second 5 (the winners average 6.4 and 7.9 seconds of watch time)
deliverables: 3 hook variants on the same body
raw footage, as the contract allows

do: Film your real phone, with client details blurred
Show the reminder going out on its own
dont: No promise of a set drop in no-shows (no percentages)
No comparison with a named competitor
No 'free forever' or 'no contract ever' wording
No client names, faces or phone numbers on screen without their written consent
Read from a script on screen
compliance: Say and show the disclosure inside the video ("ad" or "paid partnership"), not only in the caption
Use the app with your own clients before filming, and describe only what happened in your business
Say only the approved claims; never promise a number of fewer no-shows
No copyrighted music; no other booking app's logo or screen in frame
Blur or crop client names and phone numbers on screen unless the client agreed in writing
If the ad runs from your own handle (Meta partnership ads, TikTok Spark Ads), the contract records your permission and the authorisation code

launch_measurement_plan.benchmark: UGC | Salon owner | Night-before texts: hook rate 38.0%, cost per sign-up $34.63
launch_measurement_plan.step_1: After 1,000 impressions on each new video, compare its 3-second view rate with the benchmark's.
launch_measurement_plan.step_2: Judge the cost once a video has spent $103.89 (3x the benchmark's $34.63); cut any with no sign-ups by then.
launch_measurement_plan.step_3: Keep a video that beats $40.00 a sign-up, your target, and brief more creators on its hook.
launch_measurement_plan.note: A plan, not a forecast. Nothing here predicts how the videos will perform.
